intent.raw: Explore Alternate building and reframing with a hard budget to escape treating every problem as a nail.
intent.objective: Prevent sunk effort from locking the team into its first framing.
intent.target_artifact: revised choice or stable disagreement with next evidence

steps.name: robot-talks: One bounded build-counterexample-alternative cycle

outputs.purpose: revised choice or stable disagreement with next evidence

techniques.purpose: Oppose Lane Z build-plus-counterexample with Lane A genuinely different mechanism for the same problem.
techniques.validation_note: Review lane independence, a real Lane Z counterexample, solved versus reframed claims, local bridge verdict per claim, residue, and a named owner.

techniques.purpose: Convert critique into changeable assumptions, openings, alternative mechanisms, and next evidence.
techniques.validation_note: Record each attack disposition, provenance or conjecture, exposed assumption, any opening, candidate fit, and test; hard constraints or no feasible openings remain valid residue.

stop_conditions: Stop if the solution-independent problem changes.
Stop on missing causal evidence; return gap and next evidence, not a winner.
Use the shared route-wide limit of three total critique or repair rounds; this step cannot reset it.
steps.responsibility: Prevent sunk effort from locking the team into its first framing.

expected_output_contract.evidence_status: separate observation, inference, assumption, and proposed test
expected_output_contract.residue: named owner and next evidence for each unresolved claim
expected_output_contract.execution: future run output; not produced by catalog authoring
expected_output_contract.counterexample_provenance: Record observed or operator-supplied concrete cases with sources; illustrative hypothetical examples cannot pass the real-counterexample gate.

capability_metadata.status: documented capability reference; availability and lifecycle checked at run time

convergence_criteria: Stop after three rounds or when a round adds only terminology; preserve disagreement if no new evidence resolves it.
Compare all proposals against the same problem and constraints.
Preserve unresolved options; confidence does not establish a winner.

lane_contract.Z: Generate an incumbent version, attack a concrete counterexample, and revise.
lane_contract.A: At each checkpoint propose a different mechanism for the unchanged problem.
lane_contract.authority: Bridge decisions remain local; promotion-candidate grants no promotion authority.
lane_contract.counterexample_provenance: Observed or operator-supplied concrete case with a source reference; invented examples are test scenarios only.

entry_requirements: central question and assumptions stated by operator
human review of chosen concern decomposition and one rejected decomposition
named scope exclusions for every investigator
Cost of misunderstanding exceeds the cost of the bounded investigation; otherwise select S14.
One investigator would trade depth for breadth; this is contradiction discovery, not implementation.
steps.human_gate: After synthesis, human classifies tension as actionable, deferred, misinterpretation, or uncertain before downstream action.

expansion_contract.trigger: A critique exposes a potentially changeable assumption, dependency, boundary, or failure behavior.
conversion: new degree of freedom if feasible
expansion_contract.creative_goal: Expand the feasible possibility space before selecting or reducing it; incumbent repair is only one possible response.
terminal_dispositions: hard constraint with no feasible opening
expansion_contract.budget: Up to three candidates per attack, within the shared three-round route budget; option count is not success.

gates.condition: A solution-independent problem, outcome measure, constraints, decision owner, and available evidence are explicit.

The named failure test is evaluated against the unchanged problem and constraints; no rejection condition remains. Missing or inconclusive evidence preserves unresolved residue rather than selecting a winner.
gates.failure_test: Stop after three rounds or when a round adds only terminology; preserve disagreement if no new evidence resolves it.

gates.condition: This draft and any local bridge decision grant no implementation, canonical knowledge, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority. Structural validation is not effectiveness evidence.

observability.signal_grouping: dispatch_id and step_id; events describe a future run, not observed catalog execution

promotion_guardrails: Local candidate design only; external effects and canonical promotion remain separate owner decisions.

entry_contract.statement: Improve the named outcome within explicit constraints, even when the familiar tool does not fit.
entry_contract.framing_policy: Establish the stakeholder outcome and constraints during framing. The initial tool-shaped wording may be corrected; after agreement, preserve the outcome and constraints across competing solutions.

strategy.output: revised choice or stable disagreement with next evidence
strategy.use_when: The team learns during design but repeatedly defaults to polishing the same solution.
strategy.failure_mode: Endless critique consumes delivery time and keeps every option alive.
strategy.frame_expiry: New evidence changes the problem or warrants a new bounded investigation.
strategy.recomposition: The decision owner consumes this output alongside the unchanged problem brief, constraints, evidence limits, and residue to choose a next intervention.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Independent proposal and critique or concern investigation benefits this route.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Roles inspect different assumptions; they do not establish truth by agreement. This is a route design, not a confirmed executable delegation contract.

route_budget.nested_policy: Each new generation/critique cycle consumes one shared round; remaining steps do not reset the budget.
route_budget.on_exhaustion: Preserve current best candidate, stable disagreement, and next evidence; do not force a winner.
